rules.v: Excluded from labor law; terms set by contract or sponsorship only
rules.vi: Dikecualikan dari hukum ketenagakerjaan; syarat hanya diatur kontrak atau sponsor
rules.n: Labour Code art. 7 excludes domestic workers; terms set by the Unified Standard Contract and the sponsorship system. A 2020 revised contract was suspended by the Shura Council.
rules.s: Labour Code 1946 art. 7; Unified Standard Contract 2009

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Standard contract required for the work permit.

rules.v: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
rules.vi: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.v: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
rules.vi: Istirahat mingguan ada tetapi boleh diganti uang atau hari lain, atau lebih pendek
rules.n: 24 hours' weekly rest, usually spent at the employer's home.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.n: No binding rule; the 2020 contract provision is suspended.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Accommodation and food by the employer.
Recruitment office rules; fees not prohibited for workers.

rules.v: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
rules.vi: Hanya penyelesaian administratif, atau akses lebih sempit
rules.n: Civil courts and the Ministry of Labour complaints office.

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
rules.n: No right recognized for domestic workers.

decisions.nm: Recruitment agencies’ syndicate v. Ministry of Labour (standard contract)
decisions.pe: Lebanon adopted a new contract giving domestic workers a weekly day off, limits on hours and the right to resign. Recruitment agencies challenged it, and the top administrative court suspended it.
decisions.pi: Lebanon menetapkan kontrak baru yang memberi pekerja rumah tangga hari libur mingguan, batas jam kerja, dan hak mengundurkan diri. Agen perekrut menggugatnya, dan pengadilan tata usaha tertinggi menangguhkannya.

help.de: Legal consultations, shelters, medical and psychosocial help for migrant workers. Head office phone, 8am to 4pm.
help.di: Konsultasi hukum, rumah aman, bantuan medis dan psikososial bagi pekerja migran. Telepon kantor pusat, pukul 08.00 sampai 16.00.

help.de: Free, safe space for migrant workers, with free legal advice on unpaid wages and abuse.
help.di: Ruang aman dan gratis bagi pekerja migran, dengan nasihat hukum gratis tentang upah tidak dibayar dan kekerasan.

help.de: Legal, medical, social and psychological help for migrant domestic workers who face violence, abuse or exploitation. The first number is its helpline for women facing violence.
help.di: Bantuan hukum, medis, sosial dan psikologis bagi pekerja rumah tangga migran yang mengalami kekerasan, penganiayaan atau eksploitasi. Nomor pertama adalah saluran bantuan bagi perempuan korban kekerasan.
